text_block_list.text:
That morning, every single news show was 
reporting heavily on a certain story.

“Narita Brian conquers the Derby. Claims 
the second crown, one step away from the 
Triple Crown.”

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Everywhere I go, people are talking about 
the exact same thing.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Guess I can't just stay quiet like this, 
huh? Well, I'm heading somewhere where I 
can't stay quiet anyway.
(Flash! Flash!!)

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
We will now begin the Takarazuka Kinen 
contender press conference. Please raise 
your hand if you have a question.

text_block_list.name: Press Corps
text_block_list.text: Yes! Yes!! Yes!!!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
All right, the person in the 4th row, 
second from the front, please go ahead 
with your question.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, I'm with the Daily Turf. With your 
younger sister Narita Brian winning the 
second jewel of the Triple Crown recently, 
could you share your thoughts?
(Murmur...!)

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
U-Um. Please keep all questions in this 
press conference strictly related to the 
Takarazuka Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind. I had anticipated that 
question coming up anyway."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Allow me to answer. I will take 1st place 
in the Takarazuka Kinen, where the Senior 
Class's finest congregate."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"As the one who will welcome and face my 
little sister, Narita Brian, and stand at 
the pinnacle of this generation."

text_block_list.name: Press Corps
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey, that means...! Could her real goal 
be...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
This year, I plan on defeating Narita 
Brian.
(Chatter chatter chatter...!)

With that single remark from Biwa 
Hayahide, the reporters all stirred with 
excitement at once.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, swap out tomorrow's front page! The 
older sister just made an even crazier 
statement!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide-san! Please tell us a bit 
more about that!!

—Biwa Hayahide was truly the star of the 
day.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
To think I wouldn't be let go until this 
hour...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
However, everything that needed to be said 
has been said. All that's left is to give 
our absolute all in the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
“Yes. Of course, Trainer. This time, 
nothing less than first place is 
acceptable.”

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll go knock out a light evening 
routine. Nothing that'll affect tomorrow, 
of course.

Biwa Hayahide dashes off with effortless 
grace. Truly calm and composed. She really 
has grown so strong.

Also, for her to face the Takarazuka Kinen 
in peak condition—

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Huh, could it be... are you Biwa 
Hayahide-san's Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Oh, excuse me! Do you have a moment right 
now? If you wouldn't mind an interview—

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, please include us too!! Let us do a 
joint interview!

Even after the press conference ended, the 
media's fervor didn't die down at all, 
leaving me bombarded with questions late 
into the night.

"...Still, as expected of Umamusume 
reporters. They possessed an abundance of 
detailed data and predictions on the other 
contenders."
choice_data_list:
(...I should put this data to good use for 
the Takarazuka Kinen, too.)

text_block_list.text:
I turn on the computer to plan out Biwa 
Hayahide's future training schedule.
(――*vroom*)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian is in the lead! In a field 
brimming with exceptional champions, it's 
Brian who has taken the lead!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Proudly in the lead! Unquestionable 
strength! Pulling away, pulling further 
away—she crosses the finish line with a 
landslide victory in the Japan Derby!!
(Waaaaaaaaaahhhhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Brian! Brian! Brian! Brian!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Chants of 'Brian!' echo through the 
venue! This is the 'Monster'! The greatest 
Umamusume in history!!"

...The footage of Narita Brian's Derby 
playing on the computer screen.

She—Biwa Hayahide's sister— was continuing 
to grow at an extraordinary rate...!
